## What changed

Describe the resulting behavior or documentation change.

## Why

Explain the problem this solves. Link the issue, if there is one.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results, or explain why they were not needed. Use synthetic messages for dictation examples.

## Review checklist

- [ ] User-facing text and documentation are in English.
- [ ] UI changes keep keyboard focus, mouse controls and one-handed use accessible, when applicable.
- [ ] Logs, examples, screenshots and attachments contain no private audio, dictated text, writing styles or credentials.
